messages:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — planning the 'boardwalk' cutover for token-cost attribution into the new analytics pipeline tonight (T-3h). Need owners + quick sanity checks. Primary goals: preserve latency fields, keep cost mapping intact, and avoid double-counting during replay.
Ajay Patel: I can take ownership of the schema migration for token_attrib events. Will update the mapping for `token_count`, `model_variant`, `latency_ms`, `cost_microcents`. Will open the PR in ~30m.
Dena Kim: FYI ingestion team: we've seen transient backpressure during large replays (spike at decode stage). If boardwalk emits >10k/s we should gate to 2k/s canary. Can we do a phased canary? :thinking_face:
Sam Carter: +1 phased canary. Proposal: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4 hours with health checks at each step. Rollback if error rate > 0.5% or p99 latency increases >100ms.
Olga Ivanova: Heads-up on SDKs — older mobile SDKs (v0.8.x) still emit `model` instead of `model_variant`. We'll need a compatibility migration in the validation layer or a small transform in the pipeline. I can put a migration script in the PR.
Ajay Patel: Noted @Olga — will add a transform step before the dedupe stage. Draft of transform (will include in PR):
```
// pseudo-transform
if (evt.model && !evt.model_variant) evt.model_variant = evt.model;
evt.latency_ms = Number(evt.latency_ms) || null;
```
Dena Kim: Also we should preserve original event_id for dedupe. If transform alters payload we must keep `original_event_id` header.
Maria Lopez: infra question: is there capacity for the extra KV cache lookups we add for cost mapping? @infra-bot can you report expected CPU mem impact?
infra-bot: Alert snapshot: canary-cluster-3 current load 62% CPU, 71% mem. Estimated additional CPU for boardwalk mapping ~6-9% under typical traffic. No immediate quota breach.
Sam Carter: Thanks infra-bot. Given that, start canary at 0.5% for 30m to validate CPU/latency, then follow the 1/10/50/100 ramp if stable.
Olga Ivanova: I found one schema mismatch in staging where `cost_microcents` came in as string "12" — will add normalization. Also will add unit test coverage.
Ajay Patel: PR up: https://git.redwood/repo/analytics/pulls/1428 — schema updates, transform, tests. Requesting reviews from @Dena, @Olga, @Maria.
Dena Kim: Reviewing now. Quick note: ensure event timestamp timezone normalized to UTC in the PR. We've seen skewed p95 when not normalized.
Maria Lopez: CR pinged. If you see anything blocking call it out here — otherwise I'll schedule the deployment job for 21:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: pipeline/boardwalk-cutover at 2026-03-17T04:00:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/boardwalk-cutover-1979004321
Sam Carter: If deploy goes green, I will run the canary monitor dashboard checks and post results here at each gating point.
Dena Kim: Small blocker: a downstream consumer (billing-service) needs `cost_microcents` as integer; their consumer contract owner @olga said they'll coordinate a quick consumer release. Otherwise we'll add a compatibility shim in the topic.
Olga Ivanova: I'll cut the billing-service PR after boardwalk canary passes. Should be quick.
Maria Lopez: Final checklist before T-0:
- [ ] PR approvals (Ajay/Dena/Olga)
- [ ] Migration script tested on staging
- [ ] Canary job scheduled (deploy-bot done)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards hooked (Sam)
- [ ] Consumer coord (Olga)
If all good I'll flip the switch at 21:00 PT and post status updates. :rocket:
Dena Kim: Approving PR now. No code blockers from my side.
Ajay Patel: Merged after fixes. Thanks all.
Sam Carter: Canary 0.5% started — CPU delta +4%, p99 latency +12ms, error rate 0.02% -> stable. Proceeding to 1% in 40m.
Maria Lopez: Great. Keep posting canary checkpoints. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. I'll capture owners in the runbook and close this thread once we hit 100%. :white_check_mark:
